title: Ibm Security Advisories - 2026-08-31
description:
Merged 5 ibm security advisories published on 2026-08-31. Original advisory IDs: IBM-7285769, IBM-7285844, IBM-7285843, IBM-7285718, IBM-7285721

Titles:
- IBM Guardium Data Security Center is affected by multiple vulnerabilities
- IBM i is Affected By Multiple Vulnerabilities in Debug Server
- IBM i is Affected By An Improper Authentication Vulnerability in Network Authentication Service [CVE-2026-16892]
- IBM Maximo Application Suite uses IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty v.26.0.0.6 which is vulnerable to multiple CVEs.
- IBM Maximo Application Suite uses multiple third party dependencies which is vulnerable to multiple CVEs.

cves.title: CVE-2018-16487
cves.description: DOMPurify before 3.4.7 (affected versions = 3.4.5) passes direct references to the module-level DEFAULT_ALLOWED_TAGS and DEFAULT_ALLOWED_ATTR sets to the uponSanitizeElement and uponSanitizeAttribute hooks via data.allowedTags or data.allowedAttributes when sanitize is called without an explicit cfg.ALLOWED_TAGS or cfg.ALLOWED_ATTR array. A hook that mutates these fields permanently widens the default allow-lists for the lifetime of the DOMPurify instance, so all subsequent default-config sanitize calls inherit the widened defaults and attacker payloads using the poisoned tag or attribute name survive sanitization. removeAllHooks(), clearConfig(), and passing a fresh cfg do not recover the state; only constructing a new DOMPurify instance does
